messages:
maya: heads-up — saw a regression in tail latency on prod for short-chat workload after yesterday's kernel selector change.

sam: which regression? numbers?

maya: p95 jumped from 120ms -> 220ms on 1k qps test. allocation looks fine. suspect KV/prefix cache reuse dropped.

kevin: any profiling data yet?

maya: ran a quick nsys capture on the 8xA100 staging pool. attaching command + summary.

maya: ```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,osrt --output=run1 --sample=none \
  --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi -f true \
  -- python -u ./bin/serve_bench.py --workload short-chat --qps 1000 --seq-len 64
```

maya: perfetto link: https://perfetto.example/trace/abc123 (timeline shows bursty dispatches)

anya: what was the KV hitrate during that run?

maya: global kv_hit = 68% (expected ~92%). heatmap shows reuse concentrated in first 8 tokens, long tail has misses.

sam: kernel timeline showed a few long GEMM fallbacks around the misses?

maya: yes — many calls used `gemm_fp32_fallback` for 32-token windows where kernel selector opted for fallback. NVTX shows selector switching mid-request.

kevin: hmm selector heuristic probably picked small-MxN kernel due to aligned shape, but cache miss causes different shape at runtime.

maya: exact. batch boundary + prefix-eviction caused runtime seqlen variance -> kernel mismatch.

sam: quick mitigation ideas?

maya: 1) increase prefix TTL to avoid eviction for short-chat; 2) add conservative kernel pin when seqlen within [8,64] for this model; 3) prefetch KV for shared prefixes during batching.

anya: can we reproduce consistently with the smaller synthetic driver? I'll run a 10m run with deterministic seeds.

kevin: also check the batching heuristic: continuous_batching_threshold lowered in yesterday's deploy — may be grouping too many small prefixes together.

maya: noted. I'll run another nsys with `--capture-range=osrt` and log `kv_cache/lookup_latency` counters.

perf-bot: scheduled nsys job run2 on staging (job id: 4521-run2). ETA ~12m.

sam: thanks. if reproduce, we should add a short-term fallback: if kv_hit < 80% for N windows, force kernel pin to stable path.

maya: filing an action item in #incidents if run2 shows same. will paste traces and perfetto when ready. :eyes:

kevin: nice catch. :thumbsup:

maya: ok inbound run2 link when ready.
